Definition
1. ch5:weak-convergence\group chapter-5 Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0097

A sequence $x_j$ in a normed space $\V $ converges weakly to $x$ if $f(x_j)\to f(x)$ for every $f\in \V ^*$. In a Hilbert space this is equivalent to $(x_j,y)\to (x,y)$ for every $y$.
